zh: 值 1..k 在排列中各占一个不同的位置。只要这些位置之间没有空隙，它们组成的连续段里装的就恰好是 1..k。
按值从小到大依次加入，只需维护已加入位置的最左端和最右端；包围区间的长度正好等于 k 时，这 k 个位置连续。
先记下每个值所在的下标 pos[v]。令 left=n、right=−1，对 k=1..n 用 pos[k] 更新 left 和 right，若 right−left+1 等于 k 就输出 1，否则输出 0，最后拼成长度为 n 的 01 串。
en: The values 1..k occupy k distinct positions in the permutation. If those positions have no gaps between them, the contiguous block they form contains exactly 1..k.
Add values in increasing order and only track the leftmost and rightmost positions seen so far. When the length of that enclosing range equals k, the k positions are contiguous.

Record pos[v], the index of each value. Start with left = n and right = -1; for k = 1..n update left and right with pos[k], output 1 if right - left + 1 equals k and 0 otherwise, and join the results into a string of length n.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Insert the positions of the values from 1 to n in order, maintaining the leftmost and rightmost positions. When the length of that range equals the number k of values added so far, these k positions are contiguous.

## Correctness

Because the array is a permutation, the values 1..k occupy k distinct positions, all of which lie inside their minimal enclosing range. The enclosing range has length k exactly when there are no gaps, and in that case its elements are exactly 1..k.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n).
